topic: XP and levels that make effort feel like their favorite game
caption:
Your teen already knows how to level up in a game. HustleUp uses that same instinct to build real skills and real income. Every lesson completed, every hustle started — earns them XP and moves them forward. One payment of $19.99 and they keep that progress for life. See how it works → hustleup.us
